observation.visible_scene: A large floor mosaic of thousands of upright dominoes on a light wooden floor, arranged as pixel art: a yellow wedge of cheese dotted with red/orange holes set inside a blue square field, all ringed by a standing multicolored domino border. A separate wavy line of multicolored dominoes lies flat (already down) along the bottom of the frame, outside the bordered square. The camera viewpoint is fixed across all frames.
visible_changes: Frames 1-9: the cheese image, blue field, and all borders are fully upright and undisturbed; the flat bottom line shows no motion.
Around frame 10 onward: a collapse starts at the bottom-left corner of the blue field, where standing dominoes tip over into a flat dark patch.
The fallen patch expands along the bottom edge toward the center and climbs the left edge of the blue field, progressively flattening blue dominoes.
As the front advances (frames ~33-41), the lower-left pointed tip of the yellow cheese begins to fall, merging into the flattened region.
The lower segment of the left multicolored border starts toppling as the collapse reaches it; the top border, right border, and the flat bottom line remain unchanged throughout.
By the last frame, a large flat fallen zone occupies the bottom-left of the field while the upper and right portions of the image are still standing.
outside_clip_unknowns: No hand, pusher, or trigger is visible, so the cause of the initial fall is unseen.
The final state of the collapse (whether it consumes the whole image) is not shown, as the segment ends mid-process.
Whether the flat bottom line was already down before the clip began is not observable.
uncertain_details: Exact origin point of the collapse is inferred from the first disturbance at the bottom-left corner rather than seen as an impact.
The flat wavy line at the bottom is treated as static; no motion of it is confirmed within the excerpt.
